item.text: The pager stops when a page contains fewer visible records than requested, even if the gateway supplies a continuation cursor. Deleted records trigger that early stop. Projects hide the same bug by forcing a larger page size. I’ll make both exports follow continuation cursors and honor the requested page size.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Exports now follow continuation cursors until `null`, including after short or empty pages. Your example exports both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Removed the project-specific page-size workaround; projects now honor `pageSize`.

All 5 tests pass, including new regressions for deleted records, empty pages, and empty-string cursors.
